meta.name: prisma-upgrade-v7
meta.description: Complete migration guide from Prisma ORM v6 to v7 covering all breaking changes. Use when upgrading Prisma versions, encountering v7 errors, or migrating existing projects. Triggers on "upgrade to prisma 7", "prisma 7 migration", "prisma-client generator", "driver adapter required".

copy.tagline: 升级 Prisma 项目到 v7 并解决兼容报错
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你的项目还在用 Prisma 6 且准备升级到 v7
copy.tagline_en: Upgrade your Prisma project to v7 and fix breaking changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are moving from Prisma 6 to v7 and hitting issues

howto.what: 当用户处理 Prisma 6 到 7 的升级时，Claude 会按官方步骤指导：更新包、改 schema 生成器、新建 prisma.config.ts、安装驱动适配器、调整导入路径。对 MongoDB 项目会明确提示不适用，建议留在 v6。
howto.when: 当用户提到升级 Prisma 到 7、做 v7 迁移，或出现 v7 报错与 driver adapter 要求时触发。

say.text: 我要把 Prisma 从 6 升级到 7，该怎么做？
say.note: Claude 会给出完整升级步骤。

say.text: 升级后提示 driver adapter required，怎么解决？
say.note: 会引导你安装并配置驱动适配器。

say.text: 如何在新生成器里配置 CommonJS 支持？

howto.what_en: When upgrading Prisma from 6 to 7, Claude walks through the official steps: update packages, change the generator, create prisma.config.ts, install a driver adapter, fix imports. For MongoDB projects it warns not to apply the guide and stay on v6.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to upgrade Prisma to 7, migrate an existing project, hit v7 errors, or mention driver-adapter requirements.

say_en.text: How do I upgrade Prisma from 6 to 7?
say_en.note: Claude provides the full upgrade steps.

say_en.text: After upgrade, I get 'driver adapter required'. How to fix?
say_en.note: It guides you to install and configure the adapter.

say_en.text: How do I enable CommonJS in the new generator?
say_en.note: It shows setting moduleFormat in the generator.
